messages:
Meredith: Heads up — after the routing-header rollout we saw telemetry spikes where the console attributes requests to <unknown> instead of route/hash. Noticed ~4% of traces missing route tags this morning.
Kai: That matches the error budget alert. Any idea if it's SDKs or server side?
Priya: Quick triage: our canary injected the new header X-RDWD-ROUTE as JSON, but older py/ts clients send it as a compact string. Console parsing expects JSON.
Sam: Oof. We pushed a tiny shim to the ingester earlier to handle both, but it only handles top-level string -> JSON, not arrays/legacy-encoded maps. :grimacing:
devex-bot: Deploy succeeded: patch-ingester-accept-legacy-1716676000 @ 1716676000
Meredith: Can we avoid a full rollback? The Dedicated customers hit slowness if we revert routing.
Kai: Suggestion: ship a client-side bandaid in py/ts SDKs that normalizes X-RDWD-ROUTE into the canonical JSON form at send time. Minimal diff.
Priya: I mocked the transform:
```python
# py-sdk normalizer pseudo
def _normalize_route(header):
    if isinstance(header, str):
        try:
            return json.loads(header)
        except Exception:
            # legacy compact -> {"route": header}
            return {"route": header}
    return header
```
Sam: TS side will mirror that. We can release a patch 0.18.3 today with opt-in flag `normalizeRouteHeader`.
Meredith: Will that fix historical console tiles? We need dashboards to show contiguous series for the last 24h for SRE.
Kai: Console ingest only looks at the header at ingest time. New normalized headers will fix future events. For historical data we need to backfill or update mapping logic to fallback on the legacy string for attribution.
Priya: I can add a fallback path in the console mapper to interpret the compact string as route when JSON parse fails. Cheap and low-risk.
Sam: Timeline: patch ingester already; py/ts client patches in ~2-3h build + smoke. Console mapper fallback PR in next 4h.
Meredith: Add a short note in the rollout channel and tag customers likely affected (cc @support). Also add a one-line alert suppression for the next 6h to avoid noisy paging.
Kai: I'll open the support ticket template. Priya, can you add a small telemetry metric `route_header_normalized=true/false` so we can measure how many requests needed the shim?
Priya: Yep. Adding counter in ingest pipeline and SDK. Will emit counts to the console tile.
Sam: FYI: patch will be non-breaking but document opt-in flag in CHANGELOG. We'll default to off for now until we validate.
Meredith: Good. After patch, let's run a 1-hour canary on staging -> limited accounts, then promote. If metrics look good we enable by default.
Kai: A couple followups: annotate the trace parsing code with examples, and add a quick e2e test that sends both string + JSON header combos.
Priya: Will do. Also adding a tiny migration job note for backfilling route tags for yesterday's window.
Meredith: Thanks all. Post status here after the py/ts artifacts are published. :thumbsup:
